text: DEFONEOS — DEFRA Net Zero Land Use AI Governance Deep-Dive Pack EU AI Act Article 50 live 2 Aug 2026 — C2PA passport ready | Get yours → Home Master GovBench Article 50 DEFONEOS × DEFRA × NET ZERO LAND USE DEFRA Net Zero Land Use AI Governance Deep-Dive Pack Sovereign AI governance of UK net zero land use policy — peatland restoration intelligence, woodland creation analytics, agricultural decarbonisation, land use change monitoring, carbon sequestration verification, bioenergy crop governance, and environmental land management scheme optimisation. Audit-grade. Signed. UK-sovereign. 12 Entry Points 8 Transformation Priorities 6 MCP Servers 5 Backbone Orgs 🏛️ 12 Entry Points Peatland Peatland Restoration Intelligence AI-driven assessment of UK's 2.6M hectares of peatland. Condition monitoring via satellite imagery and ground sensors. Grip blocking effectiveness tracking. Sphagnum re-establishment verification. Carbon flux modelling for degraded vs. restored peatland. £1.2B+ Peatland Action Programme oversight. Woodland Woodland Creation Analytics England Woodland Creation Offer (EWCO) application scoring. Species suitability modelling using soil, climate, and topography data. Natural regeneration vs. planting cost-benefit analysis. Ancient woodland proximity screening. 30,000ha/year planting target tracking. Woodland Carbon Code verification integration. Agriculture Agricultural Decarbonisation Pathway Farm-level carbon footprint modelling across 180,000+ holdings. Methane reduction from livestock feed additives. Nitrogen use efficiency optimisation. Regenerative agriculture practice adoption tracking. Soil organic carbon measurement via spectroscopy. £2.4B ELMs scheme carbon outcome governance. Land Use Change Land Use Change Monitoring Multi-temporal satellite analysis of UK land cover change. Urban sprawl vs. green belt enforcement. Agricultural-to-solar conversion tracking. Floodplain development detection. National Land Use Database integration. Planning application environmental impact pre-screening. Carbon Sequestration Carbon Sequestration Verification UK Land Carbon Sink measurement, reporting, and verification (MRV). Above-ground biomass estimation via LiDAR. Soil carbon sampling protocol governance. Hedgerow carbon stock quantification. Peatland water table-carbon relationship modelling. Greenhouse Gas Inventory contribution tracking. Bioenergy Bioenergy Crop Governance Energy crop (miscanthus, SRC willow) land allocation governance. Biomass sustainability criteria verification. BECCS (bioenergy with carbon capture and storage) project screening. Food vs. fuel land competition analysis. Renewable Fuel Obligation compliance monitoring. ELMs Environmental Land Management Scheme Optimisation Sustainable Farming Incentive (SFI) payment rate optimisation. Countryside Stewardship transition analytics. Landscape Recovery project selection scoring. Public money for public goods outcome measurement. 70,000+ agreement holder performance tracking. £2.4B annual scheme governance. Flood Risk Natural Flood Management Intelligence NFM scheme placement optimisation using catchment hydrology models. Leaky dam, woody debris, and wetland creation siting. Agricultural land flood storage agreement analytics. Property-level protection cost-benefit analysis. Flood Defence Grant-in-Aid allocation intelligence. Biodiversity Net Gain Biodiversity Net Gain Monitoring BNG unit calculation verification (mandatory since Feb 2024). Habitat condition assessment via eDNA and acoustic monitoring. 30-year management plan compliance tracking. Off-site unit trading platform governance. Statutory biodiversity credit pricing analytics. 10%+ net gain enforcement across 10,000+ planning applications annually. Nature Markets Nature Market Integrity Voluntary carbon market quality assurance. Woodland and peatland carbon credit verification. Natural capital accounting framework implementation.
